say:1:1730510801:0.text: I don't think it's her either. The proprietor keeps out of sight most of the time.
say:1:1730510801:0.source_cn: 我也觉得不是她，我听说会馆的主人极少露面。
say:1:1730510801:0.male: I don't think it's her either. The proprietor keeps out of sight most of the time.
say:1:1730510801:0.female: I don't think it's her either. The proprietor keeps out of sight most of the time.

say:2:1730510802:0.text: It can't be Mei then. She works here every day.
say:2:1730510802:0.source_cn: 极少露面的话确实不太可能是梅了，她天天都在会馆忙上忙下。
say:2:1730510802:0.male: It can't be Mei then. She works here every day.
say:2:1730510802:0.female: It can't be Mei then. She works here every day.

say:3:1730510803:0.text: Someone once paid a ridiculous price just to meet the proprietor in person... It's an astronomical sum none of us can afford.
say:3:1730510803:0.source_cn: 我倒是听说有人花了极大的代价最终见到馆主……那样的代价...
say:3:1730510803:0.male: Someone once paid a ridiculous price just to meet the proprietor in person... It's an astronomical sum none of us can afford.
say:3:1730510803:0.female: Someone once paid a ridiculous price just to meet the proprietor in person... It's an astronomical sum none of us can afford.
